summary: QTREX Quantum Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting that on July 6, 2026, its Board of Directors approved an increase in shares reserved under its Amended and Restated 2019 Equity Incentive Plan by 3,834,244 ordinary shares (from 11,875,977 to 15,710,221). This is a routine equity plan authorization, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No deal terms, pricing, or strategic catalysts are present. The filing also incorporates the report into existing registration statements. There is no risk-arb angle or event-driven trigger.
